name: Sous
install:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use node >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$NVM_BIN:$PATH"; node --version; npm ci; [ -f .env.local ] || printf 'PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173
SESSION_SECRET=dev-local-only-not-a-real-secret
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=cooking-assistant-508423
GEMINI_API_KEY=
AUTH_GOOGLE_ID=
AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET=
ALLOWED_EMAILS=
' > .env.local

terminals.name: vite
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use node >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$NVM_BIN:$PATH"; npm run dev
terminals.description: Vite SPA dev server on http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api to :3001).

terminals.name: dev-api
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use node >/dev/null 2>&1; export PATH="$NVM_BIN:$PATH"; npm run dev:api
terminals.description: Hand-written Node API server on :3001 (chat/import/auth/sync). Prepends the nvm Node bin to PATH so node is >=22.18 (required for native TS stripping; the runtime's default node is older). Restart after editing server/ or scripts/server.ts.
